# This repository does not accept pull requests

**Please close this before spending any more time on it.** Nothing is wrong with
your change — we do not merge code from outside the team, and a bot will close
this shortly with the same message.

This is a deliberate policy, not an oversight. The reasoning is in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md); the short version is that this
code takes money at a counter, merging a patch means vouching for it at that
standard, and we would rather say plainly that we cannot than accept patches and
review them thinly.

## What you can do instead

**Fork it.** TelePOS is AGPL-3.0-or-later. You have the right to take this code,
change it, run it and distribute your version — provided your version stays
under the same licence and its users can get its source. Your fork is yours, and
nothing here restricts it.

**Open an issue instead of this pull request.** If you found a bug, the report is
worth more to us than the patch: it tells us what broke, and we would rather fix
it in a way that fits the rest of the system. Describe what you did, what you
expected and what happened — a reproduction we can follow is the single most
useful thing anyone outside the team can send.

**Tell us what you think.** Questions and criticism in the issue tracker are
welcome, including about this policy.

## If you are on the team

Delete everything above and describe the change:

- **What changes** — one or two sentences on what behaves differently after this.
- **Why** — the problem being solved; link the issue if there is one.
- **How it was verified** — commands and what they printed. "Tests pass" with no
  evidence is not verification. If you checked by hand, say what you did.
- **Money, stock or fiscal output** — if the change touches any of them, say what
  convinced you the arithmetic is right and which amounts you checked.
